The index keeps every section of the documentation together with the heading it was written under. When a question arrives, the search engine compares it with each stored section and returns the closest matches first. It is designed for teams that want answers from their own notes without sending them to a remote service. The configuration file lives next to the project, and the defaults are chosen so that most projects never need to change them. If the results look wrong, the evaluation command measures how well the index answers questions that are taken from the corpus itself. That report is a hint for tuning the threshold, and it is not a promise about the quality of every answer that users will see in practice.
